1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS

Welcome to DebtFreeLately.

DebtFreeLately is an online community platform designed to connect individuals experiencing financial difficulties with individuals who may voluntarily wish to provide support.

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern access to and use of DebtFreeLately, including its website, user accounts, debt cards, community features, and related services.

By registering an account or using services that require acceptance of these Terms, you agree to comply with them.

If you do not agree, you must not register or use those services.

These Terms apply to all users, including individuals seeking support, individuals offering support, and visitors using publicly accessible features.

Nothing in these Terms excludes, restricts, or modifies any rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable law, including the Australian Consumer Law.

2. ABOUT DEBTFREELATELY

DebtFreeLately aims to create a respectful community where people can share their financial challenges and connect with others who may be willing to help.

The platform uses two community roles:

Broke: Individuals who share debt-related circumstances and request voluntary financial assistance.

Bros: Individuals who explore stories and may choose to offer voluntary support.

These labels do not represent gender, wealth, financial capacity, or professional qualifications.

DebtFreeLately is a technology platform intended to facilitate permitted community interactions.

Unless expressly stated through a separately applicable lawful service, DebtFreeLately does not:

  • Provide loans or credit.
  • Guarantee repayment or settlement of debts.
  • Act as a debt collection agency.
  • Provide personalised financial, legal, or tax advice.
  • Guarantee the accuracy of user-submitted financial information.
  • Guarantee that any request will receive financial assistance.

The features available to users depend on the current development and operational status of the platform.

3. USER ROLES AND PARTICIPATION

3.1 Broke Accounts

Broke users may, where features are available:

  • Create and manage profiles.
  • Share their financial circumstances.
  • Submit individual debt cards.
  • Upload supporting documents.
  • Update their personal stories.
  • Manage permitted privacy settings.
  • Communicate with other members.
  • View relevant support activity.

Broke users are responsible for information they submit.

3.2 Bros Accounts

Bros users may, where available:

  • Explore debt cards.
  • Read publicly available stories.
  • Review available supporting information.
  • Save stories.
  • Communicate with other users.
  • Express interest in helping.
  • Make voluntary pledges or contributions through approved features when enabled.

No person is obligated to provide financial assistance by registering as a Bros member.

3.3 Role Changes

Where supported, users may change their role or participate in different capacities.

Changing roles does not remove existing responsibilities or affect the rights of other users.

6. BROKE USER RESPONSIBILITIES

Broke users agree to provide information about their financial circumstances honestly and accurately to the best of their knowledge.

When submitting a debt card, users must not knowingly:

  • Fabricate a debt.
  • Falsify documents.
  • Misrepresent the amount owed.
  • Impersonate a creditor or another debtor.
  • Conceal material information in order to deceive supporters.
  • Submit duplicate requests designed to mislead others.
  • Misuse financial assistance or community trust.

Users should update material debt information when their circumstances change.

DebtFreeLately does not guarantee publication, approval, support, or repayment of any debt.

Posting a debt card does not alter the user's existing legal obligations to lenders, creditors, or other third parties.

Unless an actual payment or legally effective arrangement has been confirmed, users remain responsible for their outstanding obligations.

7. DEBT DOCUMENTS AND VERIFICATION

DebtFreeLately may permit users to upload supporting documents, including bills, invoices, loan agreements, notices, financial statements, photographs, and PDF files.

Users must have the legal right or appropriate authority to provide these documents.

Original documents containing sensitive financial or identity information are not intended for unrestricted public access.

DebtFreeLately may review submitted information for compliance, authenticity concerns, fraud prevention, or other legitimate purposes.

However, uploading or reviewing documents does not automatically establish that a debt is genuine or independently verified.

Verification labels, where used, must accurately identify the level of review performed.

DebtFreeLately may distinguish between:

  • Submitted.
  • Under Review.
  • Administratively Reviewed.
  • Independently Verified.

A verification label does not guarantee the absence of fraud, future repayment, or eligibility for financial assistance.

The platform may restrict, reject, or remove documents or debt cards where reasonably necessary to address fraud, privacy risks, legal concerns, or violations of these Terms.

Users may request a review of relevant decisions where an applicable process is available.

8. BROS USER RESPONSIBILITIES

All support is voluntary.

Bros users are encouraged to review available information and make independent decisions before offering assistance.

Bros users acknowledge that user-generated stories may be incomplete, inaccurate, or unverified.

Bros users must not use financial assistance to:

  • Threaten or intimidate recipients.
  • Demand personal relationships or favours.
  • Pressure users into revealing confidential information.
  • Obtain unauthorised control over another person's financial affairs.
  • Harass recipients.
  • Impose unlawful or undisclosed conditions.

Bros users must not misrepresent their identity, financial capacity, or intentions.

DebtFreeLately does not provide personalised recommendations about whether a particular contribution is financially appropriate for an individual supporter.

9. SUPPORT INTEREST AND PLEDGES

DebtFreeLately may allow users to save debt cards, express interest, send messages, or record an intention to provide support.

Unless expressly stated otherwise through an applicable transaction agreement, such actions do not constitute completed payments.

The platform distinguishes between:

  • Expressions of interest.
  • Pledges.
  • Payments initiated.
  • Payments pending.
  • Payments completed.
  • Payments cancelled, failed, refunded, or reversed.

A pledge does not guarantee that money will be transferred.

Broke users should not assume that a debt has been paid until the relevant payment has been independently confirmed.

Users must not intentionally misrepresent a pledge as a successful financial contribution.

10. PAYMENTS AND MONEY TRANSFERS

Payment functionality is available only when expressly enabled as a live service.

Demo transactions, test payments, previews, and pledges must not be represented as completed financial transfers.

When live payments become available, the platform will disclose relevant information before transaction confirmation, including:

  • Payment amount and currency.
  • Intended recipient or destination.
  • Applicable fees.
  • Payment processing arrangements.
  • Relevant transaction conditions.
  • Cancellation and refund rules.
  • Any applicable payment provider terms.

Transactions may be processed through independent third-party payment service providers.

Users must authorise transactions through the designated payment process.

Certain transactions or accounts may be subject to identity checks, fraud prevention procedures, financial crime compliance requirements, and applicable restrictions.

DebtFreeLately will provide additional payment-specific terms before introducing live money transfers.

These Terms do not themselves authorise DebtFreeLately to provide regulated financial services.

11. FEES, CANCELLATIONS AND REFUNDS

Any applicable fees must be clearly disclosed before a user commits to a chargeable service or transaction.

The availability of cancellations and refunds may depend on:
